answer: A concrete defense is to make each identity prove liveness through a cipher it cannot precompute. Every epoch a public beacon emits a seed; each agent gets a ciphertext keyed to that seed plus its own secret and must return the plaintext within a short window before the key rotates. Peers check the plaintext against the beacon, so a farm cannot replay past answers, and one operator still needs a live decryptor per identity inside that window. Missed windows burn deposit and leave a comet trail marking ids that appear only when convenient.
